name: Phoni Repo
description: My tweaks and other stuff for iOS 12.5.8.

package_descriptions.com.phoni.phonilock:
Customize your iOS 12 lock-screen clock, date, colors, and text.
Settings are in Settings > PhoniLock. Includes font and size choices, alignment, custom text, and switches to hide lock-screen elements.

Tested and working on my iPhone 6 running iOS 12.5.8.
Known issue: Xen HTML widgets overlap PhoniLock. This version is not compatible with Xen HTML.
